text: Seeking endorsement of various events for liquor licensing purposes.

Etobicoke York Community Council, under its delegated authority, declared for liquor licensing purposes, the following events to be of municipal significance, and directed that the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario be advised that the Community Council has no objection to their taking place: 1. The night-time disco party to be held at 500 Keele Street on February 22, 2019, from 10:00 p.m. to 4:00 a.m. 2. The Annual Rotary Club Canada Day Ribfest event to be held in Centennial Park, from June 28 to July 1, 2019, from 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
